statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-15. CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. Tinyauth links the Docker client only, to read container labels for its access rules (internal/service/docker_service.go imports github.com/docker/docker/client and api/types/container). Checked with `go list -deps ./cmd/tinyauth` at v5.2.0 with docker v28.5.2+incompatible: the linked docker/docker packages are api, api/types and its subpackages, and client; no daemon, plugin manager or API server package is in the build. The melange build fails if any other docker/docker package is linked (apps/tinyauth/melange.yaml). The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
